suggestions.title: app.officeyak.com carries no noindex signal, unlike a real branch subdomain
suggestions.detail: A real tenant address such as happypanda.officeyak.com correctly gets X-Robots-Tag: noindex from src/middleware.ts, because its slug is not in APEX_LABELS. app.officeyak.com is in APEX_LABELS (src/lib/tenancy/host.ts) and is treated as apex, so it gets no X-Robots-Tag and its page has no <meta name="robots"> either. Its root page currently renders the exact same <title> as the public homepage ("OfficeYak, software for education consultancies"), so it is sitting in the open as an indexable duplicate of the homepage, and nothing stops a crawler reaching deeper than the root on that host the way robots.txt's Disallow: /app/ at least tries to on the main domain.
suggestions.why: This is tenancy and middleware code, which the brief puts outside what this routine may touch, and it is a judgement call about whether app.officeyak.com should be excluded from APEX_LABELS, carry its own noindex, or something else, not a one-line mechanical fix.
suggestions.needsYou: A decision on how the shared app shell host should declare itself to crawlers.

suggestions.title: No structured data on /software, /blog, /tools and the nine tool calculators
suggestions.detail: Reconfirmed today, unchanged from the last two reports: these 12 pages carry no application/ld+json block at all, while every /study/ page and every individual scholarship page does.
suggestions.why: Adding the right @type (SoftwareApplication or WebApplication for a calculator, CollectionPage for an index) is an editorial call, and getting the type wrong is worse than leaving it out.
